anti_overlap: fd-personality-axis-orthogonality covers axis design; this covers how axes are communicated to the AI layer
decision_lens: Curator utility — personality must be representable in the state message such that the LLM can reason about it and reference it in decisions
focus: Whether personality data is legible and actionable for the LLM curator
name: fd-personality-llm-legibility
persona: LLM prompt engineer who designs structured data formats for AI advisors in simulation games
review_areas: Evaluate how personality will be rendered in the state message (build_state_message in prompt.rs) — axis values vs labels vs behavioral summaries
Check whether 7 axes total (4 aesthetic + 3 personality) exceeds what an LLM can meaningfully track across 8-20 elves
Assess whether the curator system prompt needs personality-specific guidance (like the Name Etymology section for meanings)
Verify that personality provides the curator with actionable levers — can it recommend role changes or revel scheduling based on personality?
Check whether personality labels (e.g., 'impulsive, proud') are distinct enough from aesthetic labels (e.g., 'avant-garde, emotional') to avoid confusion

severity_examples.condition: Field exists on snapshot but not in prompt output
severity_examples.scenario: Personality data is added to ElfSnapshot but never rendered in build_state_message, making it invisible to the curator (same bug class as syllable meanings)

severity_examples.condition: Curator messages never reference personality traits
severity_examples.scenario: 7 continuous axes per elf overwhelm the curator context, causing it to ignore personality in its reasoning

severity_examples.condition: Same word used for aesthetic and personality axes
severity_examples.scenario: Personality and aesthetic labels use overlapping vocabulary (both use 'social', 'emotional') causing curator confusion

success_hints: The curator references personality naturally in its reasoning: 'Assigning Lirael as Composer — she's introverted and patient, ideal for workshop solitude.'
task_context: The game has a novel LLM curator that reads structured state and issues cultural policy commands. Every new elf attribute must be legible to this system.
